title: Tensor quotient section comparison compatible with successor mates
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring, J an ideal, and U an object of its coefficient-sized pro-etale site. Let G(M) be terminal sections on the slice of the constant sheaf of the A-module M. Let F_n be the ordinary completed quotient realization [def-sfb-adic-perfect-module-functors]. Use the right adjoints R_n and successor maps kappa_n of the completely proved SectionModel construction of [def-sfb-adic-perfect-quotient-section-model]. There exist natural isomorphisms e_n from (M maps to G(M/J^(n+1)M)) to F_n followed by R_n such that the canonical quotient section transition followed by e_n equals e_(n+1) followed by kappa_n(F_(n+1)M) and R_n(theta_n(M)). Here theta_n is the fixed ordinary balancing isomorphism. The adjunctions and their unit identity have already been proved and are not part of this assertion.

proof.text: Construct the normalized scalar comparison explicitly, using constantPresentationIso, the generator-normalized changeOverIso, adicFiniteChangeComp, and the completion cone equation. Use moduleComparison_tensor and restrictionIso to commute constant realization with extension and restriction of scalars. Use Mathlib TensorProduct.quotTensorEquivQuotSMul, with its original A-action, to identify the quotient-ring tensor with M/J^(n+1)M naturally. After restricting to the slice, invert this sheaf comparison and apply sectionsIso to get rawComparison. Define normalizedAdjunction from the concrete local constant/sections adjunction, the scalar adjunction, and this same normalization. The proved tensor quotient naturality lemma supplies the naturality field of this algebraic isomorphism.

Define rawStep by inserting the scalar-extension unit and identifying composite scalar restrictions. Its section formula inserts one in a tensor. The normalizedAdjunction unit is the constant tensor generator. Fixed balancing carries the tensor of two ones to the lower constant tensor generator, proving rawStep_unit. Compare the sheaf maps on constant quotient generators using sheafificationHomEquiv injectivity and quotient induction. Both composites carry the quotient class of x to the same lower generator. Applying localSections and naturality of sectionsIso proves rawComparison_square on all sections, including locally constant sections.

The selected SectionModel need not be the concrete record used to prove its existence. Compare its adjunctions with the normalized sections adjunctions using the unique right-adjoint isomorphisms t_n characterized by eta_can,n followed by t_n(F_n M) equals the selected unit. Put e_n=e_can,n followed by t_n(F_n M). A natural transformation beta between the right adjoints is determined by its composites with the upper adjunction unit: precompose naturality at the upper counit by that unit and use the right triangle identity. Thus the stored unit_eq shows that the selected step is the mate of inverse balancing. It is t_(n+1) inverse followed by kappa_can,n followed by C_n(t_n). Naturality of t_n along theta_n cancels the adjacent inverse factors in the successor square. This transfers the concrete quotient-section equation to exactly the selected rightAdjoint and step.

lean.statement:
theorem adicPerfectQuotientSectionComparison (X : Scheme.{u})
    {A : Type (max v (u + 1))} [CommRing A] (J : Ideal A)
    (U : coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) :
    let G := AdicCohomology.sections
      ((coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over U) (Over.mk (𝟙 U))
    ∃ (e : ∀ n : ℕ, AdicCohomology.quotient J (n + 1) ⋙ G ≅
        adicPerfectQuotientFunctor X J U n ⋙ AdicQuotientSections.rightAdjoint X J U n),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A),
        G.map ((AdicCohomology.transition J
          (Nat.add_le_add_right (Nat.le_succ n) 1)).app M) ≫ (e n).hom.app M =
          (e (n + 1)).hom.app M ≫
            (AdicQuotientSections.step X J U n).app
              ((adicPerfectQuotientFunctor X J U (n + 1)).obj M) ≫
            (AdicQuotientSections.rightAdjoint X J U n).map
              ((adicPerfectQuotientModuleStep X J U n).hom.app M)
